'''Aurodium Sword''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] faction founded by the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Muzzle/Legends|Muzzle]]. [[Snoova]] was also a member. Its function was to provide security to [[Head of State/Legends|heads of state]] and industry. It served both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and criminal organizations. The [[Sienar family/Legends|Sienar family]] was one of [[Aurodium/Legends|Aurodium]] Sword's more notable clients.

Employees of Aurodium Sword consisted of [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], and [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] got the idea for Aurodium Sword from his son, who played with a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] action figure backed up by three Wookiee action figures.<ref name="Ryan Kaufman's Star Wars Blog entry">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|42|Insider 89 "Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum & Villainy" Endnotes}}</ref>
